# Accessibility conformance report

**Package** `@revealui/presentation@0.13.0`  
**Target** WCAG 2.2 Level AA  
**Generated** 2026-07-28  
**Assessed** 11 of 64 shipped components (17%)
**Documented** 64 of 64 shipped components have showcase coverage (60 registry pages)

## How this report is produced

Generated from the component registry, not written by hand — so it cannot drift from
the code. Each row reflects the conformance claim declared in that component's
showcase definition, plus its documented keyboard and ARIA contract.

Two automated gates back these claims, both hard-failing in CI on every pull request:

- **axe-core** over every showcase page in both light and dark themes, failing on any
  violation of critical or serious impact (`e2e/showcase-a11y.e2e.ts`).
- **Contrast pins** on every token pair in the `@revealui/tokens` contract test, so a
  colour change that breaks a ratio fails the build rather than shipping.

A claim in this table means: declared by the component author, exercised by the
component test suite, and covered by the axe gate. It does not mean an independent
third-party audit — none has been performed, and this report does not imply one.

## Known issues

Documented rather than omitted. An accessibility claim that cannot be substantiated is
worse than a documented gap.

| Issue | Scope | Status |
|---|---|---|
| `--rvui-text-2` is not AA-conformant as text on `surface-2` / `surface-3` | Tertiary text on muted layers | By design — it is an icon, border and separator colour on those layers; use `--rvui-text-1` for text. Enforced by review, not yet by lint. |
| Visual regression baselines are Chromium-only | Cross-browser rendering | Known limitation. Other engines get smoke passes, not pixel goldens; cross-browser font hinting makes multi-renderer goldens unreliable. |
| No RTL support | Right-to-left locales | Deferred by decision. Components use physical-direction CSS; an RTL locale gets a broken layout, not a mirrored one. |
| No independent third-party audit | Whole package | Not performed. All claims are first-party, automated-gate-backed. |
